english.title: Cause misuse of warning beacon / lamp - Road Vehicles Lighting Act 1988

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: regulation 27 of the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989
schedule 2 to the road traffic offenders act 1988

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) caused **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..) to use on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on which a

(A)_[warning beacon emitting blue light]_
(B)_[warning beacon emitting amber light]_
(C)_[warning beacon emitting green light]_
(D)_[warning beacon emitting yellow light]_
(E)_[special warning lamp]_

was used in a prohibited manner
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 27 of the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
caused another to use on a road a vehicle
on which a warning beacon emitting blue/amber/green/yellow light/a special warning lamp
was used in a prohibited manner

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: See also H8576 and H8124 for the use and permit offences.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
